notes: «بمثل حديث وكيع» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route. The wording difference after it is left out.
Alqama (علقمة) is the speaker of the saying («ثم خرج علينا فقال»), inside Abu Wa'il's account, so he is the last link. Nahik the asker is in the scene only.
